rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an activity or task that causes fatigue.

example.english: Doing this homework is really tiring.
example.traditional: 做呢份功課真係好辛苦。
example.jyutping: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the activity itself is described from the tired person's point of view, as in 行山好攰.
